<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

The model of each module: its entities with the rules declared in the .esq files (NewX, Validate, WithDefaults), its enums, its errors, and the module itself, whose use cases other blueprints add as methods.

```esquadro
blueprint domain
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/): the app must use them too.

## Slots

Other blueprints add code at these points (see [Writing a blueprint](/esquadro/writing-blueprints/#slots)).

| Slot | |
|---|---|
| `domain.module.imports` | Import lines of each module's file, e.g. "errors". |
| `domain.module.deps` | Fields of each module's Deps, e.g. Pool *pgxpool.Pool. |
| `domain.module.errors` | Declarations in each module's var block of errors. |
| `domain.deps.values` | Fields of each module's Deps as the dependencies set them, e.g. Pool: d.pool, (in cmd/&lt;app>/dependencies.go). |

## Go modules

- `github.com/shopspring/decimal` v1.4.0
